2p5d.future_status: exploratory only if original acquisition metadata or author confirmation establishes physical adjacency
2p5d.reason: Released B-scans are strongly ordered but physical adjacency/z-spacing is not proven; representative pathological slices were selected.

outputs.column_y_distribution: derived by softmax over the y dimension of centerline logits on valid columns
outputs.distance_field: 2 channels, sigmoid normalized unsigned vertical distance

curve_head.postprocessing: presence-gated per-column peaks/distributions; do not fill unobserved gaps

geometry_task_interaction.attention_scope: joint self-attention across all region/curve/point task tokens
geometry_task_interaction.construction: three learned task-specific linear adapters and task-type embeddings applied to the same 216 fused global tokens
geometry_task_interaction.name: Geometry-Conditioned Task Interaction Transformer
geometry_task_interaction.purpose: learn spatial/anatomical dependencies among heterogeneous biomarker tasks without imposing unsafe hard region-point rules

global_encoder.decoder_only_encoder_frozen: required ablation, not the primary full model
global_encoder.pretraining: official retinal OCT/SLO/layer multimodal foundation-model weights

global_token_fusion.ablation: final MIRAGE block only vs blocks 3/6/9/12
global_token_fusion.method: project each selected MIRAGE layer 768->256, concatenate four layer features channel-wise, then linear fuse 1024->256 per spatial token
global_token_fusion.why_multilevel: combine intermediate local/structural and deeper contextual MIRAGE representations

input.normalization: MIRAGE-compatible OCT normalization; exact numeric normalization verified from official wrapper during implementation

local_detail_encoder.purpose: restore high-frequency local information that may be attenuated by 32x32 ViT patches; particularly important for small IRF, ELM/EZ, and HF

stage_stride2.operator: 3x3 stride-2 convolution + normalization + GELU + one ConvNeXt-style local block

stage_stride4.operator: 3x3 stride-2 convolution from stride2 + two ConvNeXt-style local blocks

per_task_patch_expansion.expansion: learned 8x8 patch reassembly from patch-32 tokens

stride2_local_fusion.operation: bilinear upsample task feature x2, concatenate local-detail stride-2 feature
